title: Marion County Commission, District 2
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Primary result from WCJB (https://www.wcjb.com/2026/08/19/two-marion-county-commission-primary-races-decided/) and 352today; write-in opponent per ClickOrlando voter guide and Ocala Gazette. Official list: https://www.votemarion.gov/210/Candidates (not directly readable).

candidates.name: Mike Crimi
candidates.background: Marion County resident of more than 50 years. Won the open-seat Republican primary (incumbent Kathy Bryant did not seek re-election); campaign reported raising nearly $120,000.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18 Republican primary with about 55% over Matthew Cretul and Brien Weidemiller (WCJB)
